topic.title: Self-Build / Custom Housebuilding / Serviced Plots

scope_guards: Entry on a demand register is not treated as allocation of a plot.
Registered demand is not treated as a deliverable site capacity.
A planning allocation is not treated as permission.
Planning permission is not treated as a serviced plot.
A serviced-plot commitment is not treated as completed utility connections.
A land disposal offer is not treated as completed acquisition.
A build contract is not treated as completed and occupied housing.
No score or promotion is written without exact register, permission, plot, services, land transfer, build and occupation evidence.
